Folder.title: Folder
Folder.body: Organizes project files without affecting playback or property inheritance. Folders can nest, but cannot sit inside audio objects or the Busses section.

Sound.title: Sound
Sound.body: Plays the source selected in Sources for the current platform and language. A Sound has no child objects; use a Container to vary what plays between triggers.

Container.title: Container
Container.body: Selects or mixes child Sounds, Containers, Tracks, and Pieces using Random, Sequence, Match, or Blend mode. Nest Containers to combine selection rules.

Track.title: Track
Track.body: Places Sound, Container, or Piece clips on one timeline. Each clip starts at its scheduled time and plays using the child's settings; overlapping clips play together.

Piece.title: Piece
Piece.body: Aligns several Tracks on a shared timeline, with Entry, Exit, and Custom markers for playback timing. Editing uses absolute time; existing musical timelines are read-only.

Layer.title: Layer
Layer.body: Groups audio objects and applies shared properties to their playback. Volume and pitch add to each descendant's values; a Layer cannot be played directly.

Bus.title: Bus
Bus.body: Mixes incoming audio and passes it through its own controls to the parent bus. Nested buses form the output path to the Master Bus.

Action.title: Action
Action.body: Runs audio commands from one trigger: play, stop, set a Variable, post another Action, or reset Container memory. Configure the operations and their timing in Steps.

Variable.title: Variable
Variable.body: A game-controlled value used by parameter bindings and Container selection or mixing. Each Emitter uses its local override when present, otherwise the global value; buses use the global value. A Global write clears all Emitter overrides.

Attenuation.title: Attenuation
Attenuation.body: Defines how volume and pitch change with distance from the listener. Editing this asset affects every object that references it.

mixnode.volume.title: Volume
mixnode.volume.body: Gain in dB (-96 to +24); 0 leaves the level unchanged. Content-object gains add along the playback hierarchy.

byType.Bus: A Bus applies this gain to its combined inputs.

mixnode.pitch.title: Pitch
mixnode.pitch.body: Pitch offset in cents (-4800 to +4800); 100 cents is one semitone. Content-object offsets add along the playback hierarchy.

byType.Bus: Bus pitch is currently unsupported: keep it at 0 to allow audition and pack export.

mixnode.outputBusId.title: Main Output
mixnode.outputBusId.body: The parent bus receiving this bus's output. Read-only here; move the bus in the tree to change its parent.

mixnode.mainOutputBusRef.title: Output Bus
mixnode.mainOutputBusRef.body: The bus receiving this object's main output. Inherit follows the parent's Output Bus and Output Volume together; clear it to choose a local bus, which cannot be empty.

mixnode.outputBusVolume.title: Output Volume
mixnode.outputBusVolume.body: Gain on the main output route (-96 to +24 dB), independent of Sends. Content objects inherit this with Output Bus; parent values do not add together.

byType.Bus: On a Bus, this trims the route to its parent.

mixnode.sends.title: Sends
mixnode.sends.body: Additional routes alongside the main output. Set a Target bus and Volume (-96 to +24 dB) for each send; each target can appear once.

audio.loopCount.title: Loop
audio.loopCount.body: Total playback passes: 1 plays once; Infinite repeats until stopped. Set this on the object that should repeat.

byType.Container: For a Random or Sequence Queue, each pass is one complete round.

spatial.spatialPanning.title: Panning
spatial.spatialPanning.body: Left/right position of the 2D image: -1 left, 0 center, +1 right. With 3D enabled, it affects the 2D portion set by Spatialization Mix.

spatial.spatialIs3DEnabled.title: Enable 3D Spatialization
spatial.spatialIs3DEnabled.body: Positions mono or stereo audio relative to the listener using the Emitter's position. Distance changes follow the selected Attenuation; without one, distance applies no attenuation. Turn off to use the 2D image.

spatial.spatialAttenuationDistanceScalin.title: Distance Scale
spatial.spatialAttenuationDistanceScalin.body: Scales the distance range of the selected Attenuation (10% to 1000%). 100% uses the original range; 200% makes it reach twice as far.

spatial.spatialAttenuationRef.title: Attenuation
spatial.spatialAttenuationRef.body: Shared distance curves used when 3D Spatialization is enabled. With Inherit off, an empty reference means no distance attenuation.

selection.mode.title: Mode
selection.mode.body: Random selects by weight; Sequence follows list order. Match selects one row using Variable conditions; Blend plays all configured members together and controls their gains with Variable curves.

bus.pan.title: Pan
bus.pan.body: Bus panning is currently unsupported: keep this at 0. A nonzero value prevents audition and pack export.

bus.inputs.title: Inputs
bus.inputs.body: Read-only summary of main output routes into this bus and their levels. Edit Output Bus or Output Volume on the source; move a child bus in the tree to change its route.

bus.receives.title: Receives
bus.receives.body: Read-only summary of send routes into this bus and their levels. Edit Sends on the source object to change them.

variable.kind.title: Kind
variable.kind.body: Step rounds values to integers; Smooth keeps fractional values. Changing Kind also adjusts Range and Default Value.

variable.range.title: Range
variable.range.body: The Variable's minimum and maximum values, both nonnegative. Values are clamped to this range; narrowing it preserves labels outside the range.

variable.defaultValue.title: Default Value
variable.defaultValue.body: The value used before any write. It stays within Range and is rounded to an integer for Step Variables.

variable.labels.title: Labels
variable.labels.body: Names for integer values, used in displays and Match conditions. A fractional value shows a label only if its nearest integer has one.

sound.scheduleOffsetSec.title: Offset of Start
sound.scheduleOffsetSec.body: Delay in seconds before this Sound starts, for every source. 0 starts immediately.

item.notes.title: Notes
item.notes.body: Project notes for this object; they do not affect playback.

spatial.spatializationMix.title: Spatialization Mix
spatial.spatializationMix.body: Blends the 2D image (0) with positioning from the Emitter (1) for mono or stereo audio. Requires 3D Spatialization; distance attenuation still applies at 0. This value is shared across platforms.

selection.selections.title: Selections
selection.selections.body:
Random uses Frequency to control draw chance (0 excludes an entry), or Order to bias shuffle order; Sequence follows list order. Match uses Variable conditions to choose one row.

In Blend, each mixing row gives its children independent 0–100% gain curves, without normalization; gain is 0% outside a curve's span, and a row without a Variable contributes 100%. All members play together, including at 0%; a child used in several rows shares one playback, with the row gains multiplied.

selection.behavior.title: Behavior
selection.behavior.body: Repetition and selection memory settings for Random and Sequence. Available controls depend on Mode and Play Type.

sound.distinguishLanguage.title: Language
sound.distinguishLanguage.body: Keeps separate sources and Active choices for each language. When enabled, edit the language groups in Sources; a missing language does not fall back to another.

sound.sources.title: Sources
sound.sources.body: Import or drop audio files here; click a waveform to edit that source's trim and loop region. Active selects the source to play for the current platform. Setting Active with all platforms selected replaces the shared choice and clears platform overrides.

action.steps.title: Steps
action.steps.body:
Each row sets an operation, target, and Delay from the Action trigger, in seconds. Expand a row for its options.

Play starts the target; Stop ends it with an optional fade.
Set Variable writes a Global or Emitter value; Global clears Emitter overrides.
Post Action triggers another Action.
Reset clears Random or Sequence selection memory; Queue reset is Emitter-only.

tracktimeline.clips.title: Clips
tracktimeline.clips.body: Schedules child playback at each clip's start time. The displayed width does not trim playback; length, loops, and fades follow the child. Overlaps play together without an automatic crossfade.

attenuation.dimensions.title: Dimensions
attenuation.dimensions.body: Edit Volume (−96 to 0 dB) and Pitch (−1200 to 1200 cents) over distance. All curves share a distance axis from the listener to Max Distance.

selection.discipline.title: Discipline
selection.discipline.body: For Random Single, Draw selects by Frequency on each trigger. Shuffle uses Order weights to arrange a round, then selects each entry once before starting another round.

selection.avoidRepeat.title: Min Repeat Gap
selection.avoidRepeat.body: How many other selections must occur before the same list entry can repeat in Random. 0 adds no repeat restriction; the maximum is 8 or the number of eligible entries minus one, whichever is smaller.

selection.memoryScope.title: Memory Scope
selection.memoryScope.body: For Random or Sequence Single, Per Emitter remembers selection progress separately for each Emitter; Global shares it across Emitters. Queue always keeps separate Emitter memory.

selection.resumeFromLast.title: Resume From Last
selection.resumeFromLast.body: Start a queue from this Emitter's saved entry. When disabled, or no entry is saved, start a new round.

selection.variableResponse.title: Variable Response
selection.variableResponse.body: Fixed holds the starting Match selection or Blend gains; Live updates them as Variables change during playback. This does not freeze property Bindings or keep completed content playing.

selection.playType.title: Play Type
selection.playType.body: Single selects one entry per trigger; Queue plays a full round, with Loop setting the number of rounds. Random Queue shuffles the entries by Order weight and plays each once per round; Sequence Queue follows list order.

ProjectSettings.title: Project Settings
ProjectSettings.body: Edit project platforms, languages and publishing options. Completed edits take effect immediately, support Undo, and are saved with the project.

Preferences.title: Preferences
Preferences.body: Edit the editor appearance, shortcuts, layouts and extensions. Changes take effect immediately. AI connection changes require Save Connection and are discarded when this panel closes.

RemoteConnect.title: Remote Connect
RemoteConnect.body: Discover running applications or connect by address. Closing this panel keeps the active connection.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Settings take effect when an edit is completed. Project changes can be undone and are saved with the project. AI connection changes require Save Connection and are discarded when Preferences closes.

settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.appearance.body: Set the editor theme and Information language.

settings.appearance.theme.title: Theme
settings.appearance.theme.body: Choose the editor's appearance; the selected theme takes effect immediately. Install additional themes in %1.

settings.appearance.language.title: Information Language
settings.appearance.language.body: Choose the Information help language; the editor interface and project audio languages are unaffected.

settings.extension.developer.title: Developer Mode
settings.extension.developer.body: Show File and Version columns in Publisher.

settings.layout.title: Layout
settings.layout.body: Save, rename or delete layouts. Changes take effect immediately. Default cannot be renamed or deleted.

settings.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
settings.shortcuts.body: Double-click a shortcut and finish recording new keys to rebind it immediately; right-click to clear or restore its default. Resetting all shortcuts requires confirmation.

settings.ai_agent.credentials.title: Credentials
settings.ai_agent.credentials.body: Set the service URL, model, context size in tokens, and API key, then choose Save Connection. Unsaved connection changes are discarded when Preferences closes. Saving an empty API key removes it from the system credential vault.

settings.ai_agent.connection.title: Test Connection
settings.ai_agent.connection.body: Send a short request with the current URL, model, and API key from the input field, without saving settings.

settings.ai_agent.permission.title: Permission
settings.ai_agent.permission.body: Read-only blocks writes; Ask requires approval. Auto currently also asks for every write; Legacy Bypass behaves as Ask.

settings.config.title: General
settings.config.body: Set the project's target platforms and audio languages.

settings.config.platforms.title: Platform Configuration
settings.config.platforms.body: Select a platform on the left to edit its name, base platform, and build settings. Completed edits take effect immediately and can be undone. Use + to preview and add a supported platform. Reset restores the base platform defaults. Platform editing is unavailable while platform work is in progress. At least one platform must remain.

settings.config.languages.title: Language Configuration
settings.config.languages.body: Define audio languages for Sounds with Language enabled. Names use A-Z, a-z, digits, and underscores.

settings.publish.title: Publish
settings.publish.body: Set the export directories and choose which additional material to include.

settings.publish.output.title: Publish Directory
settings.publish.output.body: Choose the directory for exported packs. Paths are relative to the project when possible; otherwise an absolute path is kept, such as on a different Windows drive. Blank uses BuildPacks. The project root and object directories cannot be used.

settings.publish.additional_material.title: Additional Material
settings.publish.additional_material.body: Optionally export Project.json, metadata in each pack's companion JSON, and <hash>.vkd waveform buffers.

settings.publish.project_information.title: Export Project Information
settings.publish.project_information.body: Write Project.json in Publish Directory, alongside the platform folders. It contains optional project information for external tools and is not required to load runtime packs.

settings.publish.pack_metadata.title: Export Pack MetaData
settings.publish.pack_metadata.body: Include metadata in each pack's same-named JSON file, such as Init.json or <action>.json, beside its .bytes file.

settings.publish.waveforms.title: Export Wave Buffer
settings.publish.waveforms.body: Export waveform preview buffers as <hash>.vkd files in Waveform File Directory. Each pack's same-named JSON lists these files in its waveforms field.

settings.publish.waveform_directory.title: Waveform File Directory
settings.publish.waveform_directory.body: Choose where <hash>.vkd waveform buffers are written. Paths are relative to the project when possible; otherwise an absolute path is kept. Blank uses BuildPacks/Waveforms. The project root and object directories cannot be used.

Blueprint.title: Blueprint
Blueprint.body: View and edit object relationships and audio routes. Drag pins to connect objects; Volume nodes control the gain of an output or send.

Explorer.title: Explorer
Explorer.body: Browse and organize project objects and source files; select an object to inspect its properties.

Inspector.title: Inspector
Inspector.body: Edit the selected object's properties. Clear a group's Inherit checkbox to edit its local values.

Information.title: Information
Information.body: Read help for the object or control under the pointer; use the title-bar lock to keep the current topic.

Control.title: Control
Control.body: Adjust preview Variable values for the selected object and view their effects on bindings and selections. These values are temporary.

Log.title: Log
Log.body: Review editor messages, warnings, and errors to diagnose problems.

Publisher.title: Publisher
Publisher.body: Manage pack contents and export runtime packs for the selected platforms.

Monitor.title: Monitor
Monitor.body: Search and filter captured runtime events; select a record for details or jump to its project object.

Assistant.title: Assistant
Assistant.body: Ask questions about the project or request edits through the enabled tools; writes require approval.

blueprint.select.title: Select
blueprint.select.body: Click or box-select cards, drag them to move, and drag pins to connect objects.

blueprint.pan.title: Pan
blueprint.pan.body: Drag to move the canvas view.

blueprint.snap.title: Snap to Grid
blueprint.snap.body: Align cards to the grid when moving them.

blueprint.viewportFilter.title: Viewport Filter
blueprint.viewportFilter.body: Hide Sound objects and their connections from the canvas without changing the project.

blueprint.viewportVisibility.title: Viewport Visibility
blueprint.viewportVisibility.body: Choose which waveforms and properties appear on cards.

blueprint.resetLayout.title: Reset Layout
blueprint.resetLayout.body: Reset manually placed cards to the automatic layout.

blueprint.zoom.title: Zoom
blueprint.zoom.body: Choose a zoom level or Zoom to Fit to frame the visible cards.

list.add.title: Add
list.add.body: Add an entry to this list.

list.remove.title: Remove
list.remove.body: Remove the selected entry from this list.

audition.play.title: Play
audition.play.body: Start a preview of the selected playable object or Action.

audition.reset.title: Reset Container Selection
audition.reset.body: Clear the selected Random or Sequence Container's preview selection memory, including queue progress.
